name: What does a luxury custom kitchen in Los Angeles usually cost per square foot?

mainEntity.name: What does a luxury custom kitchen in Los Angeles usually cost per square foot?
mainEntity.text: What does a luxury custom kitchen in Los Angeles usually cost per square foot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury custom kitchen pricing in Los Angeles is usually driven more by scope than by a single flat price. Homeowners should expect a wide range because custom cabinetry, premium countertops, appliance packages, lighting, and structural changes can push costs up quickly. A small luxury kitchen may cost far more per square foot than a large one because fixed costs such as design, permits, demolition, and trades are spread across fewer square feet. The best way to budget is to separate the project into three buckets: construction, cabinetry and millwork, and finish selections. If the design includes moving walls, rerouting plumbing, or upgrading electrical service, the price can rise substantially. For planning purposes, ask for a line-item estimate and compare what is included, especially cabinet construction, hardware, appliance allowances, and installation. In Los Angeles neighborhoods with higher-end finishes, pricing tends to climb further due to labor, logistics, and custom material selections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury custom kitchens in Los Angeles often fall well above standard remodel pricing because they include full custom cabinetry, premium stone, integrated appliances, and layout changes. A realistic planning range is usually expressed per square foot, but the final number depends on size, structural work, and finish level.
